title: Sparse Autoencoders Can Induce Local Geometry for Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting
abstract: arXiv:2610.22439v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Catastrophic forgetting remains a challenge in supervised continual learning, as adapting to new tasks causes representation drift and loss of previously learned information. This raises the question of which representational changes should be constrained while preserving plasticity. We therefore introduce Sparse Autoencoder Geometric Anchoring (SAGA), which converts a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) trained at each task boundary into local, low-rank constraints on representation drift. Replay examples specify where the constraints apply, while leading right singular directions of the encoder Jacobian specify which changes are penalized. The resulting geometry is input dependent and can be retained without keeping the SAE for subsequent tasks' training. translated_title: 稀疏自编码器可以诱导局部几何以缓解灾难性遗忘
translated_abstract: 灾难性遗忘仍然是监督式持续学习中的一个挑战，因为适应新任务会导致表示漂移和先前学习信息的丢失。这引出了一个关键问题：在保持可塑性的同时，应该约束哪些表示变化。为此，我们提出了稀疏自编码器几何锚定方法，它将在每个任务边界训练的稀疏自编码器（SAE）转换为对表示漂移的局部、低秩约束。重放样本指定约束应用于何处，而编码器雅可比矩阵的主右奇异方向指定惩罚哪些变化。由此产生的几何结构依赖于输入，且在后续任务的训练中无需保留SAE即可维持。我们建立了该方法与潜在码匹配之间的局部关系，定义了其谱截断误差，并推导出冻结读出层漂移的条件界。通过结合重放和快照历史，该方法（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SAGA方法，将每个任务边界训练的稀疏自编码器转换为对表示漂移的局部低秩几何约束，从而在保持可塑性的同时有效缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SAGA, which converts sparse autoencoders trained at each task boundary into local, low-rank geometric constraints on representation drift, effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting in continual learning while preserving plasticity.
